goon.institution.civilian_desk.name: Neighborhood Civilian Desk
goon.institution.civilian_desk.routine: One daily round reads the shop board and asks the resident coordinator; the final public circular is collected after issue.
goon.institution.civilian_desk.mandate: Local notices and safety assistance. A verified delivery record permits one dated correction copy; no money, legal finding or automatic recipient correction.

goon.institution.police_intake.name: GCPD Intake Desk
goon.institution.police_intake.routine: Receives a next-day copy of Ada's actually delivered alarm report and later owner review through the existing incident desk.
goon.institution.police_intake.mandate: Log, classify and acknowledge observations. A logged cause is not proof of guilt; no suspects, warrants, charges or arrests. Administrative delivery disputes belong at the civilian desk.
